title: 建設マネジメントⅠ
subtitle: Social Project Management I
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) learn what is meant by “social construction projects”.
(2) learn procedures followed in railway projects.
(3) learn general policies with respect to road traffic.
(4) learn the realities of international construction projects.
advice:
This course deals with the management of social construction projects. We will cover the following topics:

1. What social construction projects entail.
2. Railway projects: planning, design, construction, maintenance, and management.
3. Road traffic policy: changes in road policies in Japan, effects of road network formation, road stock effects, etc.
4. International construction projects.

Precautions
The lectures described above are special lectures by invited professional engineers involved in each
   project.
Students are required to actively participate in class.
The schedule of the special lectures is subject to change.
Rreference documents and practice problems will be distributed to students as appropriate.
